studio_jpeg_research_interop.baseline_rule: Known-good interoperability reference only. Verify current Studio main is clean/green and schema-compatible before live research; do not reset Studio to this SHA merely because it is recorded here.
studio_jpeg_research_interop.fully_bound_definition: Exact sealed stimulus + Studio-independent verification of Claude's execution receipt/model/actions on the exact Creator assembly + stock output observation + independent Studio/Creator JPEG parser agreement.
studio_jpeg_research_interop.family_measurement_rule: Studio family analysis consumes fully_bound current-corpus cases only. measurement_ready is quantitative controlled evidence, not JRE PASS.
studio_jpeg_research_interop.one_piece_reference_rule: E01/E02/E03/E04/E07 geometry is remeasured by Studio against fully-bound native E00 dough-only output, with a second E00 repeat as native save/render noise reference when available.
studio_jpeg_research_interop.e10_rule: E10 action/model round-trip binding alone is insufficient for JPEG determinism. Studio must separately retain and bind first native Save and post-reload re-Save JPEG write events, independently cross-validate both, and complete their differential before E10 family measurement_ready is true.
studio_jpeg_research_interop.jre_readiness_rule: Studio v1.2 reports campaign inputs fully bound, mapped family measurements ready, and source/runtime proof still required as separate layers; only Claude may promote the JRE contract.
studio_jpeg_research_interop.next_action_rule: Studio next-action routing chooses work only. It may read the Creator JRE contract when locally available but never writes it or auto-executes Claude-owned JRE state changes.
studio_jpeg_research_interop.ownership_rule: Claude consumes Studio-generated stimuli/evidence/control status read-only and owns only the Creator exact-model/native-operation executor plus Creator source/runtime/JRE adjudication. Claude does not edit Studio/Workbench implementation.

Implement research-only exact controlled stimulus executor
requirements: Accept only creator-0.11.272 stimulus documents that validate against the shared stimulus schema.
Build/bind PizzaModel directly from the explicit stimulus; do not run the Barro's placement generator or invent transforms.
Preserve model.placements array order exactly; there is no competing sequence field.
Resolve each exact ingredient ID and size through IDatabaseService and native dough positions through GetPizzaShape(shape).DoughPositions.
Use IPizzaCreatorService.LoadPizzaFromModel for the exact stimulus model.
When requested, invoke SaveCurrentPizzaToRecipes through the existing native service; do not encode or rewrite the JPEG in the research executor.
When requested, reload through the native recipe-book route, require exact ModelSignature agreement, then invoke the same native save path again.
For every executed case emit one JSON receipt conforming exactly to contracts/creator-controlled-execution-evidence.schema.json.

The receipt must include exact stimulus SHA, Creator repo SHA, exact Assembly-CSharp SHA, observed model/order/transforms, requested/attempted/success action receipts with timestamps, and exact reloaded_model when reload verification is requested.
Return/provide the receipt path to Studio's canonical observer; a missing or mismatching receipt must keep the case below fully_bound.
Keep Studio/Workbench implementation read-only and outside this change.

parallel_research.execution_rule: Use Studio's next-action router/control panel as the default orchestration path. Do not create/hand-pick a competing case corpus, family analyzer, ledger, or next-action engine. Supply the exact execution-evidence receipt for every run so Studio can independently bind stimulus -> Creator model/actions -> stock output.
parallel_research.e10_execution_rule: For E10, retain accurate native first-save/reload/re-save action timestamps in the execution receipt. parallel_research.truth_rule: cross_validated means stock-output/parser agreement without proven executor binding. fully_bound additionally requires Studio verification of the exact Creator execution receipt/model/actions. measurement_ready is a Studio quantitative family result over fully_bound evidence and still does not replace source/runtime proof or promote a JRE gate.
